description: Recent records from a common Kansas City, MO open dataset (data.kcmo.org) by friendly name — no Socrata id needed. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "recent crime in Kansas City, MO", "Kansas City, MO 311 requests", "Kansas City, MO building permits". Names: 311, crime. Returns the latest rows (newest-first). Add a SoQL `where` to filter; for anything else use kcmo_query.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

where.description: Optional SoQL filter. Omit for all recent rows.

name: kcmo_recent
title: Kcmo Recent
